question: How can a participant react on the shared expense assignment?

sections.beforeHtml: A participant reacts to the shared amount assigned to them from the Trip participants page. The reaction controls appear only on the current participant`s own row when a shared amount is assigned.
items: Open Dashboard > Trip personal > Participants for the selected trip.
Find your own participant row. Plantour shows the shared assignment status there, including the deadline when one is set.
Click Accept if you agree to take responsibility for your assigned shared amount.
Click Reject if you do not want to take responsibility for that assigned amount.
After you accept, Plantour keeps that shared amount assigned to you and tracks the balance through your personal shared payments.
After you reject, Plantour marks your current shared assignment as rejected so the admin can review and update it.
Plantour notifies the admin when you accept or reject the assignment.
sections.afterHtml: Accepting is the bridge from shared assignment to personal payment tracking. After acceptance, continue with What can a participant do after accepting the expense assignment?.
